specs.title: GPU draws compiled colors, geometry and real font glyphs alongside scoped DOM
strict GPU rejection retains the drawn style, partial reports skipped properties and deleting classes restores defaults
GPU responds to pointer, keyboard focus-visible and disabled input without recompiling
GPU media uses the browser viewport, and alpha color blocks match DOM pixels
GPU applies text resources, row layout, shadows and rings from compiler bindings
GPU restores its latest committed programs after a real WebGL context loss
terminal GPU initialization failure explains recovery while DOM editing remains usable
all non-button GPU boundaries are visible and the desktop comparison frames align
SDK ensure installs scanner-free CSS, coalesces requests and isolates independent scopes
controls apply classes and fit desktop and mobile
nested owners stop outer rules and disposal removes the owned stylesheet
classList changes and newly added subtrees compile through the bounded observer without scanner
scoped relation variants and arbitrary selectors retain conditional matching
arbitrary responsive conditions follow the browser viewport at both sizes
color alpha and scoped placeholder selectors retain their browser semantics
